DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お持ち帰りをご予約の方ですね。お名前を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You have a takeaway reservation, correct? May I have your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 五時半受け取りで予約したリンです。仕事が延びて、六時過ぎになりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約名と仕事による受取遅延を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm Lin, booked for collection at five thirty. Work is running late, so it looks like I'll arrive after six.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give your booking name and explain collection is delayed by work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: リン様ですね。まだ仕上げる前なので、受け取り時刻を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Lin, understood. We haven't finished preparing it yet, so I'll check the collection time.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 六時半なら確実に来られます。その時刻に合わせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 来店可能な時刻へ受け取り変更を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can definitely come at six thirty. Could you adjust it to that time?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request collection to be changed to a time you can come. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 注文の内容を確認してから調整します。握り二人前でお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the order before adjusting it. Is it two servings of nigiri sushi?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、二人前です。量は変えず、受け取りの時刻だけ変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文量は変えず時刻だけ変更すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, two servings. I want to change only the collection time, without changing the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that only the time will change and the quantity will remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。六時半にお渡しする予定として準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. We'll prepare it for planned collection at six thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もしさらに遅れそうになったら、この電話番号へ連絡すればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 再度遅れる場合の連絡先を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: If it looks like I'll be even later, should I contact this phone number?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whom to contact if delayed again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、わかった時点でご連絡ください。お渡しのときに持ち帰りの注意もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please contact us as soon as you know. We'll also explain the precautions for taking it home when you collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 六時半に伺い、遅れる場合は電話します。受け取ったら宿へまっすぐ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 変更時刻と遅延連絡および受取後の帰路を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll come at six thirty and call if I'm delayed. After collecting it, I'll go straight back to my accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Give the changed time, delay notification plan and route after collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、変更を承りました。それでは六時半に、お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then we've accepted the change. We'll see you at six thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご乗車の前に、予約画面を確認させていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Before boarding, may I check your booking screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらです。大阪方面と書いてあったので、このバスだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約画面を提示し行き先だけで判断したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here it is. It said toward Osaka, so I thought it was this bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the booking screen and explain that you judged by destination alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 行き先は同じですが、こちらは別の便です。予約の出発時刻を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The destination is the same, but this is a different service. Let's look at your reserved departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 画面には十四時二十分とあります。今来ている便には乗れないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約時刻を読み現在の便に乗れるか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The screen says fourteen twenty. Does that mean I can't board the service that's here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Read the booking time and check whether you can board the current service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この予約のままでは乗車できません。お客様の便はもう少し後に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can't board with this booking unchanged. Your service will arrive a little later.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 早い便への変更はしません。予約した便を待つ場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 便を変更せず予約便の待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't change to the earlier service. Please tell me where to wait for the one I reserved.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Keep the booking and ask where to wait for the reserved service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この停留所でお待ちください。バスが来たら、便の表示と時刻を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please wait at this stop. When the bus comes, we'll check its service display and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 大きいかばんは、予約便が来てから係員に預ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 大きい荷物を預けるタイミングを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Should I leave my large bag with the attendant after the reserved service arrives?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm when to hand over your large luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、荷物の扱いもその便の係員に確認してください。今はお手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please also check luggage handling with that service's attendant. Keep it with you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: かばんを持ってここで待ちます。乗る直前に十四時二十分の便か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 荷物を手元に置き予約便の時刻を再確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll wait here holding my bag. Just before boarding, I'll check that it's the fourteen-twenty service.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Keep your luggage with you and say you will recheck the reserved service time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。それでは、ご乗車までお気をつけてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do that. Take care while waiting to board.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もうお帰りですか。入口の前で何かお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you leaving already? Is there a problem in front of the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一緒に来た友人が見当たりません。出口で集合する約束でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 出口で集合予定だった友人とはぐれたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I can't find the friend I came with. We'd agreed to meet at the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you have lost contact with a friend you planned to meet at the exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの出口という約束でしたか。携帯電話で連絡は取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Did you agree on this exit? Can you contact them by mobile phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 出口の名前までは決めていませんでした。電話は呼び出し音が鳴りますが、応答がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 集合出口の曖昧さと電話がつながらない状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We hadn't decided the exit's name. The phone rings, but there's no answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the ambiguous meeting exit and unanswered phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別の出口で待っているかもしれませんね。服装など、わかることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: They may be waiting at another exit. Please tell us what you know, such as their clothing.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 成人の男性で、緑の上着を着ています。白い帽子もかぶっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人の年齢区分と服装を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: He's an adult man wearing a green jacket. He also had a white hat on.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give your friend's age category and clothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その特徴で係員にも確認します。お客様は移動せず、ここでお待ちになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll ask other attendants using that description too. Can you stay here without moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、ここにいます。友人には入口の案内板の横で待つとメッセージを送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 待機場所を固定して友人にメッセージを送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I'll stay here. I'll message my friend that I'm waiting beside the information board at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Fix your waiting location and message your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。連絡がついたら、こちらにもお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do. If you make contact, tell us too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今、返事が来ました。別の出口にいたので、この案内板まで来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 返信が届き案内板で合流することを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: They've just replied. They were at a different exit, so I'll ask them to come to this information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Report the reply and that you will meet at the information board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 連絡が取れてよかったです。それでは、お友達と合流したらお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'm glad you made contact. Once you meet your friend, please take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 印刷機の操作でお困りですか。どの画面まで進みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you having trouble with the printer? Which screen have you reached?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一枚印刷できましたが、文字が小さすぎます。明日の面接で提出する書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 印刷済み書類の文字が小さく提出用途があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've printed one sheet, but the text is too small. It's a document to submit at tomorrow's interview.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the printed text is small and the document is for submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 元のファイルは何ページですか。複数のページを一枚にまとめる設定になっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: How many pages is the original file? Is it set to combine multiple pages onto one sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 元は二ページです。画面で二枚を一枚にする項目を選んだ気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 元のページ数とまとめ印刷を選んだ可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The original has two pages. I think I selected the option to put two pages on one sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give the original page count and the possibility you selected combined printing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その設定だと文字が小さくなります。まとめない設定を探してみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: That setting makes the text smaller. Let's find the setting that doesn't combine them.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 書類の内容は自分で確認しますので、設定の場所だけ教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 内容を見せず設定箇所だけの案内を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the document contents myself. Could you show me only where the setting is?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request guidance only to the setting without showing document contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、内容を見る必要はありません。こちらの設定画面で選び直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, there's no need to see the contents. Please select again on this settings screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二ページを別々に印刷する設定にしました。料金も画面で確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 個別ページ設定へ直し画面の料金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've set the two pages to print separately. I'll check the price on screen before proceeding too.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Correct the individual-page setting and check the displayed price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その順番で大丈夫です。出てきた用紙を確認し、端末に残したデータにもご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: That order is fine. Check the printed sheets and be mindful of any data left on the terminal too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 今度は読める大きさで出ました。用紙をそろえて、データの終了操作もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 読める印刷結果と用紙回収および終了操作を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: This time it printed at a readable size. I'll gather the sheets and also finish the data session.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Report the readable print result, collecting the sheets and ending the session. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 印刷できてよかったです。それでは、書類をお忘れにならないようにお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'm glad you could print it. Please remember your documents when leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 税についてのご相談ですね。お持ちの書類はご本人宛てでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You're asking about tax. Are the documents addressed to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 職場でもらった封筒です。表に会社の名前があり、自分が払う税なのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会社名の封筒を渡され自分の納税か迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's an envelope I received at work. The company name is on the front, and I'm unsure whether it's tax I need to pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain receiving a company-name envelope and being unsure whether it is your tax payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会社宛てのものなら、ご本人への請求とは限りません。中の書類の宛名も確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: If it's addressed to the company, it isn't necessarily a bill for you. Let's also check the addressee on the document inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 本文も会社宛てです。私の名前は、どこにも書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本文も会社宛てで自分の名前がないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The body is addressed to the company too. My name isn't written anywhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that the document is addressed to the company and your name does not appear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、まず職場で、この書類を渡された理由を確認するとよさそうです。別にご自身の税の相談もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then it would be best to first ask your workplace why you were given it. Do you have a separate question about your own tax too?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 去年の源泉徴収票は持っています。申告について聞きたいのは、その書類のほうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本人の源泉徴収票について別の申告相談を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have last year's withholding statement. That's the document I want to ask about for my declaration.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Present a separate declaration inquiry about your own withholding statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご本人の相談はこちらですね。申告済みかどうかなど、状況を伺ってから整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: So this is your own inquiry. Let's organize it after asking about the situation, including whether you've already filed.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 封筒の書類と源泉徴収票を分けておきます。今日は自分の申告の相談を進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会社宛て書類と本人資料を分け相談範囲を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll keep the envelope documents separate from the withholding statement. Today I'd like to proceed with advice about my own declaration.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Separate company-addressed documents from your own and specify the scope of advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。会社宛ての書類については、職場で確認した結果をメモしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. For the company-addressed documents, please note what you learn when you check at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 会社の担当者には封筒を渡された理由を聞きます。自分の相談では源泉徴収票を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 職場への確認事項と本人相談に使う資料を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll ask the company staff why they gave me the envelope. I'll use the withholding statement for my own inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Organize what to check at work and the documents for your own advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい、書類の区別ができましたね。それでは、ご相談の席へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes, we've distinguished the documents. I'll take you to the consultation seat.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今朝は地面がぬれていますね。道具を持って畑に入る前に、足元を見せてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-01.translation: The ground is wet this morning. Before entering the field with tools, please show me your footwear.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長靴の底に泥が詰まっています。洗ってから戻ったほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 靴底に泥が詰まっていると報告して対処を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mud is packed into the soles of my boots. Should I wash them and come back?
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report mud packed into your soles and ask what to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず通路の端で泥を落としましょう。今の靴で斜面を上がるのはやめてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's remove the mud at the passage's edge. Don't go up the slope in those boots as they are.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下の区画だけなら作業できますか、それとも今日は待機ですか。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 斜面を避けても作業を始められるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can I work if I stay only in the lower plot, or should I wait today?
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can start work while avoiding the slope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下の区画も私が見てから判断します。先に空の収穫箱を屋根の下へ運んでおいてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll inspect the lower plot too before deciding. First, carry the empty harvesting boxes under the roof.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱に昨日の品種名が残っていますが、ラベルは外してよいですか。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱に残った品種ラベルを外す前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday's variety name is still on the boxes. May I remove the label?
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check before removing the variety labels left on the boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 昨日の担当に確認するので、今はそのまま重ねてください。濡れた箱は別に置きましょう。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with yesterday's worker, so stack them as they are for now. Let's keep wet boxes separate.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この二箱は底が濡れています。乾いた箱と分けて、入口の内側に置きます。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 濡れた収穫箱を分ける置き方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bottoms of these two boxes are wet. I'll separate them from the dry boxes and put them just inside the entrance.
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you will separate the wet harvesting boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その置き方で大丈夫です。畑の確認が終わるまで、休憩所で待っていてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-09.translation: That arrangement is fine. Please wait at the rest area until the field check is complete.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では箱を置いてから休憩所へ行きます。収穫の開始は呼ばれるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収穫開始の指示まで休憩所で待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll put the boxes down and go to the rest area. I'll wait to start harvesting until I'm called.
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will wait in the rest area for instructions to start harvesting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 私が戻ったら声をかけます。ひとまずお疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-WKY-TANABE-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll speak to you when I return. Thank you for your work so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図を広げていらっしゃいますね。どの辺りまで歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a map open. How far are you planning to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と展望場所まで行くつもりでしたが、帰りのバスまで二時間しかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復に使える時間が二時間だけだと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to go to the viewpoint with my friend, but we only have two hours before the return bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have only two hours available for the round trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この地図の往復時間には休憩が含まれていません。お二人ともこの道を歩いたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The round-trip time on this map doesn't include breaks. Have both of you walked this route before?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人とも初めてです。道を探す時間も考えると、今日は難しそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者も自分も未経験で計画が難しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the first time for both of us. Including time to find the route, it looks difficult today.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both you and your companion are inexperienced and the plan looks difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね、時刻だけを頼りに急ぐのはお勧めしません。友人の方には予定変更を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, I wouldn't recommend rushing based on the time alone. Have you told your friend about changing the plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は先に入口へ行きました。携帯がつながらないので、ここで待っていてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連絡できない同行者を待つ場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend went ahead to the entrance. I can't get through on the phone, so may I wait here?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss where to wait for a companion you cannot contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口の手前から見えるベンチなら待てます。私からも入口に向かう前に様子を見ますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can wait on the bench visible from before the entrance. I'll also check the situation before heading to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではベンチから動かずに待ちます。戻ってきたら、登らないことを直接話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口近くで待って同行者に中止を伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll stay on the bench without moving. When they return, I'll tell them directly we're not going up.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to wait near the entrance and tell your companion the plan is canceled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人の方がこちらへ戻ってきましたね。バス停の場所も二人で確認してから出発してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your friend is coming back here now. Please both check the bus stop's location before setting off too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合流できて安心しました。今日は山へ入らず、二人でバス停へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者と合流して山歩きを取りやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm relieved we've met up. We won't enter the mountain today; we'll head to the bus stop together.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have reunited and will cancel the mountain walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけてお帰りください。また余裕のある日にお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care going home. Please visit again on a day with more time.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 上着をご覧ですね。室内で着るものをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at jackets. Are you looking for something to wear indoors?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物を棚に上げる仕事で着ます。腕を上げたときに袖が突っ張らないものが欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物を上げる仕事で使う上着の条件を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for work lifting luggage onto shelves. I want something whose sleeves don't pull when I raise my arms.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the jacket requirements for work lifting luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの試着用をお使いください。普段の服の上から着てみると、動きやすさが分かりますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this try-on item. Trying it over your normal clothes will show how easily you can move.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 着てみましたが、腕は動かせても袖口が手にかかります。短い袖のものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袖口が長い試着結果を伝えて別の型を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've tried it. I can move my arms, but the cuffs cover my hands. Is there one with shorter sleeves?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report the long cuffs from trying it on and look for another model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 隣の型は袖が少し短いので、そちらも試してみてください。胴回りは今のものと違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The model next to it has slightly shorter sleeves, so try it too. The body circumference differs from this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらは手が出ますし、背中も引っ張られません。洗濯機で洗えるか、表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 動きやすさを比べて洗濯表示の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: With this one my hands are exposed, and my back doesn't pull. I'd like to see the label to check whether it's machine washable.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare movement and ask where the washing label is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示はこちらです。洗い方が仕事先の決まりにも合うか、確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The label is here. Please check that the washing method also matches your workplace's rules before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場では洗濯ネットを使っています。この表示なら対応できそうなので、こちらにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場の洗い方を踏まえて購入する型を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We use laundry nets at work. This label looks compatible, so I'll choose this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a model to buy based on the workplace washing method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ではこの一着ですね。試着したものと、持ち帰る商品のサイズ表示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then this one jacket, correct? Let's check the size labels on the one you tried and the one you'll take home together.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも同じサイズでした。紺色の一着をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試着品と購入品のサイズと色を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both were the same size. One navy-blue jacket, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the size and color of the tried and purchased items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お包みしますね。ありがとうございました、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll wrap it. Thank you, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。まだお箸を付けていないようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What is the matter? It looks like you haven't started eating yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 温かいうどんを頼んだつもりでしたが、この器には冷たいつゆが入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食べる前にうどんの温度が注文のつもりと違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd ordered hot udon, but this bowl contains cold broth.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before eating, explain that the udon's temperature differs from what you intended to order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取り口でお渡しした器ですね。注文を確認するので、レシートを拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the bowl handed over at collection, correct? May I see your receipt to check the order?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。「冷」とあるので、私が注文を押し間違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートを示して自分の選択ミスの可能性を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It says cold, so I may have pressed the wrong option when ordering.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and acknowledge you may have selected the wrong option. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録も冷たいものになっています。今の器はそのまま置いて、変更できるか厨房に確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The record also says cold. Leave the bowl as it is and let me check with the kitchen whether we can change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。器を持って戻るとこぼしそうなので、ここに置いたままでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: こぼさず確認するため器をその場に置いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please check. I might spill it carrying it back, so may I leave it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to leave the bowl in place while checking so you do not spill it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、私が運びます。厨房では変更を受けられるそうなので、温かいものをお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll carry it. The kitchen says they can change it, so I'll bring you hot udon.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。追加の支払いがあるなら、先に金額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理変更の追加料金を先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If there's any extra payment, please tell me the amount first.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check any additional charge for the food change in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回は追加の支払いはありません。こちらが温かいうどんですので、注文と合うかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's no additional payment this time. Here is the hot udon; please see whether it matches your order.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今度は合っています。熱いので、器を動かさずにここでいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換後の料理を確かめてその席で食べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's right this time. It's hot, so I'll eat here without moving the bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the replacement food and say you will eat at that seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ごゆっくりどうぞ。お帰りの際は足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy. Watch your step when leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談ですね。何をなくされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a lost item. What did you lose?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青い布袋です。駅から商店街へ歩く途中で、手に持っていないことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: なくした布袋と紛失に気づいた経路を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A blue cloth bag. While walking from the station to the shopping street, I realized I wasn't holding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the lost cloth bag and the route where you noticed the loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に袋を確認した場所は覚えていますか。袋の外側に目印もあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where you last saw the bag? Please also tell me any identifying marks on the outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅のベンチに座ったときはありました。持ち手の片方に白い糸で名前を縫っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に袋を見た場所と縫い付けた目印を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had it when I sat on the station bench. My name is sewn in white thread on one handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the last place you saw the bag and the sewn identifying mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の中には何が入っていましたか。持ち主を確認する際の手掛かりになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: What was inside? That can help identify the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作業用の手袋と、会社名が書かれた赤い手帳です。財布や鍵は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋の中の手袋と会社の手帳を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Work gloves and a red notebook with my company's name. There was no wallet or key inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specifically describe the gloves and company notebook inside the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました、届け出の内容を記録します。見つかったときに連絡できる番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood, I'll record the report. Please give a number we can contact when it's found.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この携帯番号でお願いします。仕事中に出られない場合は、折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先と仕事中に応答できない場合の対応を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This mobile number, please. If I can't answer at work, I'll call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give contact details and what you will do if unable to answer during work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では番号と袋の特徴を一緒に確認してください。駅への問い合わせは、駅の窓口にも直接お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please check the number and bag description together. Please also ask the station desk directly about the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記録の内容は合っています。このあと駅の窓口にも聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遺失記録を確認して駅にも問い合わせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The record is correct. I'll ask at the station desk after this too.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the lost-item record and decide to ask the station too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋が見つかるとよいですね。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-TANABE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope your bag is found. Take care on your way home.
